results.wikipedia_summary: Chasmanthe aethiopica, the cobra lily, is a perennial plant and geophyte belonging to the genus Chasmanthe and is part of the fynbos. The plant is endemic to the Eastern and Western Cape. The plant grows to a height of 40 to 65 cm and flowers from April to July. The flowers are red-purple.

results.wikipedia_summary: Delosperma lehmannii is a succulent plant native to parts of the Eastern Cape Province of South Africa. Sometimes called ice plant, it is grown as a decorative houseplant for its distinctive smooth, angular leaves. The specific epithet lehmannii honors the German professor of botany in Hamburg Johann Georg Christian Lehmann.

conservation_statuses.description: Precautionary location protection applied to limit dissemination of precise coordinates for a location-sensitive taxon potentially vulnerable to targeted disturbance. Native orchid species occurring in Greece are protected under Presidential Decree 67/1981 (national), Council Regulation (EC) No 338/97 (European Union), and CITES Appendix II (international). Wild harvesting of orchids (e.g. for salep production) has been documented as a pressure on certain populations. This designation is intended as a risk-reduction measure only and does not represent a formal conservation assessment.
